stem_book: Consider the expression E = (i^592 + i^590 + i^588 + i^586 + i^584)/(i^582 + i^580 + i^578 + i^576 + i^574) − 1. Which of the following statements about E is/are correct? (a) E = −2 (b) The numerator of the fraction in E evaluates to 1 (c) The denominator of the fraction in E evaluates to −1 (d) E is a purely real number [MULTI CORRECT]
reason: 'numerator/denominator of E' clarified to 'of the fraction in E' (E itself is the fraction minus 1)
